Ram Temple Donation Theft Allegations Spark Controversy

Allegations of theft from Ram Temple donations have surfaced, leading to demands for strict action and raising questions about security. The controversy has cast a shadow over the RSS centenary year, with reports of significant amounts of money and valuables allegedly being involved in various theft incidents across the country.
